headline: Executive order updates federal civil service rules about political activity by government workers.
what_it_does: This order changes the Civil Service Rules, which set workplace rules for many federal employees, in the part dealing with political activity. The title does not explain exactly what was changed. It was signed the same day the Hatch Act Reform Amendments of 1993, a law on federal workers' political activity, took effect, but the title alone does not confirm how the two are connected.

who_it_affects.how: The rules on what political activities they may or may not take part in were changed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 3, 1994; the exact effective date is not stated in the title.
